4.name: TEXT_REGSEA5BROENBHAR_00769_BROENBHAR_000_000
4.description: Every marauder goes through the same brutal trainin', an' it's that sense o' kinship what binds the guild together. I'm always willin' to go the extra malm for a fellow axe-wielder.

5.name: TEXT_REGSEA5BROENBHAR_00769_BROENBHAR_000_010
5.description: I'm proud to have had a part in yer trainin', <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Ye've become one damn fine marauder, an' the example I point to when one o' me novices ain't swingin' as hard as <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> should!

6.name: TEXT_REGSEA5BROENBHAR_00769_BROENBHAR_000_020
6.description: Ye've the makings of a fine warrior. But don't you go forgettin' what ye learned here at the guild. All them fancy new techniques mean nothin' without good basics an' fundamentals.

7.name: TEXT_REGSEA5BROENBHAR_00769_BROENBHAR_000_030
7.description: The guild? Same as it's ever been, though I suspect things'll liven up when the others hear ye've paid us a visit.

8.name: TEXT_REGSEA5BROENBHAR_00769_BROENBHAR_000_031
8.description: An' we've no shortage o' fresh faces about neither, younglings eager to live up to yer feats o' heroism.

9.name: TEXT_REGSEA5BROENBHAR_00769_BROENBHAR_000_032
9.description: 'Course none of 'em can break boulders quite like you could, heh heh heh.

10.name: TEXT_REGSEA5BROENBHAR_00769_BROENBHAR_000_100
10.description: Should duty demand we return home for one reason or another, the Ironworks has agreed to lend us use o' their airships.

11.name: TEXT_REGSEA5BROENBHAR_00769_BROENBHAR_000_101
11.description: So don't ye worry none, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>, I'll always be where me axe is needed most.

12.name: TEXT_REGSEA5BROENBHAR_00769_BROENBHAR_000_110
12.description: There <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> is, the hero o' the hour! Knew ye had it in ye to bring down the tower. 'Course everyone had their part to play─we certainly had our hands full keepin' guard o' the delegations an' subduin' the tempered.

13.name: TEXT_REGSEA5BROENBHAR_00769_BROENBHAR_000_111
13.description: Who would've thought, when everythin' was said an' done, we'd all get together round a stove to break bread, eh? Never dreamed o' such a thing afore joinin' the contingent.

14.name: TEXT_REGSEA5BROENBHAR_00769_BROENBHAR_000_112
14.description: Met some damn fine warriors out there, especially them Au Ra from Othard. Might've even picked up a trick or two watchin' 'em fight.
